name: Ansys CFX Computational Fluid Dynamics
description: Drive Ansys CFX computational fluid dynamics from AI agents — build and edit CFX-Pre cases, launch and monitor solver runs, and extract results through CFD-Post. Full session support requires Ansys CFX on Windows; the bundled PyCFX backend covers non-GUI operations.
capabilities: Author and modify CFX-Pre simulation cases
Launch, monitor and stop CFX solver runs
Inspect model context and mesh state
Drive multi-step CFD workflows end to end
